stem.text: What can be deduced from a table of wavelengths of the waves in the electromagnetic spectrum?

A.text: Green light has a shorter wavelength than X-rays.

B.text: Red light has a shorter wavelength than green light.

C.text: The wavelength range for radio waves is less than that for infra-red waves.

D.text: The wavelength range for X-rays is less than that for radio waves.
